svg.title: Mask2D slices across a warp
svg.desc: A lower-node mask held by a warp, one x-slice per lane.
svg.text: One warp per node: lane x holds x-slice x as a Mask2D (lower node shown)
lanes 16–31: empty slices (take part in shuffles only)
x-slice 7 (lane 7): bit y·16 + z, in 4 words
MaskShift<di, dj, dk>, one unit step per axis
each word is shuffled between lanes (__shfl_down/up_sync);
lanes whose source lies outside the node take zeros.
the slice shifts as one 256-bit integer by 16 bits (one
y-row), carrying bits between neighboring words.
each word shifts by 1 bit; a constant mask clears the bits
that would cross into the neighboring y-row.
A sweep ORs the six unit shifts of the interior, keeps the open slots,
and stops when __any_sync finds no slice changed.
